device.meaning: A /dev path that resolves under /dev to an observable, unmounted block device after guard checks. The stop limits its complete UTF-8 input to 65536 bytes.

test_type.meaning: Filesystem check only (quick), or bad-blocks and filesystem checks (full).

started.meaning: The transient unit was observed active; this does not report the eventual test verdict.

device.meaning: The requested device after form validation; null can be returned on a guard failure.

runningDevice.meaning: Device parsed from the already-running unit description, if available.

runningMode.meaning: Mode parsed from the already-running unit description, if available.

mounted.meaning: Node and mountpoint pairs protecting the device from testing.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The launch or preflight signal; none after a witnessed start. Detached worker outcomes are not returned by this stop.
